snippet.title: Bygone Dreams - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The official announcement trailer for the upcoming action-adventure Bygone Dreams from Bosnian developer Prime Time Studio.

Follow our Kickstarter campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2038970320/bygone-dreams?ref=5l5s9n
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/951620/Bygone_Dreams/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/bygonedreams

Bygone Dreams is a fantastical third person action-adventure game set in a surreal dream world. The game takes players on an unforgettable adventure featuring elements from Slavic mythology and medieval Bosnian folklore.
